newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Bank sees good bank environment in 97.
newsitem.headline: HK Bank sees good bank environment in 97.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd general manager Christopher Langley said he saw a positive environment for the territory's banks in 1997.

Langley told a media briefing Hong Kong's overall economic picture for the coming year was good, with gross domestic product growth seen rising, tourist arrivals expected to surge, and economic growth of important trading parters picking up.
He also expressed hope for progress during the year on China's entry into the World Trade Organisation and resolution of trade disputes about Chinese textile exports.
"If you take all these things into consideration, I think we should be looking at quite a positive environment for the banking industry in the territory in 1997," Langley said.
He added Hong Kong's stock and property markets were also firmly underpinned, with the exception of the luxury property market.
Hongkong Bank is a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc.
